description: Annual dynamics of global remote industrial heat sources dataset from 2012 to 2021 is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Caihong Ma et al. The spatiotemporal distribution of industrial heat sources (IHS) is an important indicator for assessing levels of energy consumption and air pollution. Continuous, dynamic monitoring and publicly available datasets of global IHS (GIHS) are lacking and urgently needed. Coverage: global; published in 2024. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support industrial-facility and resource studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
